entries.text: Imagine a mountain of money. Now imagine that one person owns the peak, while everyone else shares the pebbles at the bottom.
In America, the gap isn't just growing; it is becoming a canyon.
The top one percent hold more wealth than the entire bottom ninety percent combined.
This isn't just about luxury. It is about the fundamental breaking of the American Dream.
